title: Checkpoint data not pushed when agent commits and pushes in the same turn

verdict.rationale: The evidence shows deferring condensation to turn end for sessions committed while ACTIVE was deliberately designed: a commit fixed dropped condensation so it is dispatched at TurnEnd, and another stores PendingCheckpointID so turn-end condensation matches the commit trailer. The ordering relative to pre-push is a consequence of that design, not mentioned as a concern.

Fix checkpoint ID mismatch and unsafe shadow branch deletion at turn-end

Two bugs found by cursor[bot] review:

1. PostCommit's ActionMigrateShadowBranch path (ACTIVE → ACTIVE_COMMITTED)
   didn't store PendingCheckpointID, so HandleTurnEnd generated a new ID
   that mismatched the commit trailer. Now stored during migration.

2. handleTurnEndCondense deleted shadow branches without checking for other
   active sessions, unlike PostCommit which gates deletion on
   activeSessionsOnBranch. Added hasOtherActiveSessionsOnBranch check.
